user.description: Casita answers with the local agent first, then with your LLM agent, and shows an emotion with every reply.

data.emotion_fallback_ai_task: Pick missing emotions with the AI Task

data_description.llm_agent: Answers what the local agent does not handle. Leave empty to only use local commands.
data_description.local_first: Handle the commands Home Assistant understands before asking the LLM. Disable "Prefer handling commands locally" in the voice assistant using Casita, Casita already does it.
data_description.ai_task_entity: Used to restyle local replies and to pick missing emotions.
data_description.restyle_local: Rewrite local replies in the voice of Casita. The original reply is kept if the rewrite loses a number, gets too long or takes too long.
data_description.restyle_timeout: After this time the local reply is used as is. Use a fast AI Task model without extended thinking.
data_description.emotion_fallback_ai_task: When the LLM reply has no valid emotion tag, the AI Task picks the emotion.
data_description.extra_personality: Added to the personality of Casita. For example how it calls you or a running joke.
data_description.weather_entity: Rain makes Casita a bit less cheerful.

error.ai_task_required: Pick an AI Task entity to restyle replies or pick emotions.
